journey.name: Wear - Swipe Dismiss Back Stack
journey.description:
Verifies the back stack rules of the watch app. Swipe-to-dismiss always pops exactly one screen, a screen the user finished with (the reply picker, a review screen) is never shown again on the way back, and the feed and thread keep their scroll position under the screen that was on top of them.
Run on a round Wear OS emulator with the bench build. Start with the app stopped. Type by tapping the on-screen keys (see docs/wear-testing.md).

actions.action: Launch Nubecita on the watch with the bench scenario "default"
Tap Home
Scroll down with the rotary crown until the post by Cleo Marsh that begins "The lake was perfectly still" is in the middle of the screen, and record which post is in the middle
Tap the post by Cleo Marsh
Verify that the post by Cleo Marsh is shown on its own screen
Scroll down to the Like, Repost and Bookmark controls and tap Repost
Verify that a dialog asks "Repost this?"
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen
Verify that the dialog is gone and the post by Cleo Marsh is still shown
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen
Verify that the feed is shown with the recorded post still in the middle of the screen
Scroll up to the top of the feed and tap the feed header
Verify that the list titled "Feeds" is shown
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen
Verify that the feed header still reads "Following"
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen
Verify that the landing screen is shown
Tap Messages and tap the conversation "Weekend Trip"
Verify that the thread is shown with its newest message, "I'll bring snacks."
Tap Reply
Verify that the reply screen with quick replies is shown
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen
Verify that the thread is shown with "I'll bring snacks." still its newest message
Tap Reply and tap "Speak or type"
Verify that the system text input screen is shown
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen
Verify that the reply screen with quick replies is shown
Tap "Speak or type", tap the keyboard choice, type "ok" by tapping the on-screen keys, and tap the keyboard's Send key
Verify that the review screen titled "Your reply" shows the text "Ok"
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen
Verify that the reply screen with quick replies is shown and no message was sent
Tap "Thanks!"
Verify that the thread is shown with the bubble "Thanks!" after "I'll bring snacks."
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen
Verify that the conversation list is shown
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen
Verify that the landing screen is shown
Tap New post, tap the keyboard choice, type "back test" by tapping the on-screen keys, and tap the keyboard's Send key
Verify that the review screen titled "New post" is shown
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen
Verify that the landing screen is shown and nothing was posted
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen
Verify that Nubecita is no longer on screen
